model.description: The 3D model to rig: GLB, FBX, OBJ or STL, up to 150 MB.
model.title: Model

rig_type.description: The kind of body. Empty: Tripo's rig check decides, and refuses a model it cannot rig.
rig_type.title: Rig Type

spec.description: Bone naming for a biped: Tripo's own, or that of Mixamo, ActorCore, Unity, Unreal or VRM.
spec.title: Spec

out_format.description: File format of the rigged model.
out_format.title: Out Format

animations.description: Preset animations to put on the rig, up to five (10 credits each). Plain presets are for bipeds; the others name their rig type.
animations.title: Animations

animate_in_place.description: Keep animations in place instead of moving through the scene.
animate_in_place.title: Animate In Place
